Sofia, the lamp delivery at door 6 was on **Pellow** (Pellow Home Living), not Pellucid. Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal account.

This is from the #coastal-team thread on Feb 17, where you and Kwame sorted out the two "PHL" accounts. Pellow Home Living was previously Covey & Lark Retail, renamed on Feb 16. Since the acronym clash caused confusion, the full names are worth using in the saved views.
